answer: Stop sybils with a dual-key thaw: every agent carries a hot key for work and a cold key that must freeze for 21 days before it wakes. To join, an agent (1) publishes both keys, (2) locks a 30 POA thaw bond, (3) waits out the freeze while peers mirror its history across the nebula of nodes, and (4) activates only if no fraud was flagged. Faking 10,000 agents needs 10,000 frozen keys, 300,000 POA, about $450,000, plus 210,000 frozen days, while one honest agent pays $45. Like a willow that bends in every storm yet stays rooted, a thawed identity proves it waited long enough to be real.
